RIVERMARK EDUCATION SYSTEMS, INC.
ORDER FORM #OF-2026-011
Governing terms: Master SaaS Agreement dated December 15, 2025

Customer:           Sagebrook Education, Inc.
Execution date:     December 15, 2025
Subscription start: January 1, 2026
Subscription term:  Thirty-six (36) months (January 1, 2026 through
                    December 31, 2028)

PRICING AND PAYMENT TERMS

1. Rivermark FA Platform Pricing. Customer will pay Rivermark the following
   fees for the Rivermark FA Platform:

   (i)  Annual Subscription fee of $180,000 for up to 25,000 End Users
        processed using the Rivermark FA Platform during each twelve (12)
        month period of the subscription term.

   (ii) In the event that the number of End Users processed during any
        twelve (12) month period exceeds 25,000, Rivermark shall invoice
        Customer for such additional End Users processed at a Price Per End
        User of $3.00. Prior to invoicing, Rivermark shall provide Customer
        with a calculation of the number of End Users processed during the
        previous twelve (12) month period.

2. Implementation Services. One-time Implementation Services fee of $90,000
   for standard implementation of the Rivermark FA Platform, consisting of
   configuration, data migration, and administrator training per Section 3.1
   of the Access Terms.

3. Invoice Schedule.

   Annual Subscription fee:        invoiced annually in advance on the first
                                   business day of each subscription year.
   Implementation Services fee:    invoiced upon execution of this Order
                                   Form.
   End User overage fees (if any): invoiced annually in arrears following
                                   the End User calculation for the
                                   applicable subscription year.

   Payment terms: Net thirty (30) days per Section 4.1 of the Access Terms.

TOTAL FIXED FEES UNDER THIS ORDER FORM (36 months): $630,000

Executed by authorized representatives of the Parties:
Rivermark Education Systems, Inc.   Date: December 15, 2025
